split.method: chronological, no shuffling: train 70% / val 10% / test 20% (by whole days)

evaluation.scheme: rolling-origin on test period, fixed models trained on train (val for early stopping)
evaluation.mase: MAE / in-sample seasonal-naive MAE on train (m=288 for 5-min, m=24 hourly)
evaluation.mape_eps: points with |y| < 5% of train median |y| are ignored in MAPE
evaluation.coverage80: share of actuals inside [q10, q90]; only probabilistic models

assumptions: Long-horizon models use weather as known future covariates; in training/evaluation the ERA5/archive values are used (perfect-forecast assumption), so live accuracy with Open-Meteo forecasts may be lower.
Short-horizon models use only sensor history + hour of day.
Chronos-Bolt is used zero-shot (no fine-tuning), with up to 2048 context steps.
Neural models (LSTM, N-HiTS, PatchTST) are global models across the 9 series with per-window robust scaling.
Final live models are refit on all data with the step/iteration count selected by early stopping.
Metrics are computed only on observed (non-imputed) points; origin-target pairs with insufficient context are excluded for all models equally.

validity_rules.dht20_zero_pair: temperature==0 and humidity==0 -> both NaN (DHT20 read failure)
validity_rules.cwt_zero_block: EC==N==P==K==0 simultaneously -> those 4 NaN (Modbus read failure)

preprocessing.resample: mean on 5-min grid, label = bucket start, Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh
preprocessing.outliers: Hampel centered window=7 (±15 min), threshold=5.0*1.4826*max(MAD, floor), floor={'temperature': 0.2, 'humidity': 0.5, 'soiltemp': 0.2, 'moisture': 0.5, 'pH': 0.05, 'EC': 0.02, 'N': 5.0, 'P': 5.0, 'K': 5.0}
preprocessing.interpolation: linear, only interior gaps <= 6 steps (30 min); longer gaps stay NaN
preprocessing.hourly: mean of 5-min values per hour (label = hour start), requires >= 6/12 valid points
preprocessing.causal_eval_cleaning: in rolling-origin evaluation the Hampel+interpolation is re-run on the history before each origin only
preprocessing.metric_actuals: metrics are computed only on actually observed (non-imputed, non-outlier) target points

xgb_feature_leakage_test.note: post-origin target values replaced by noise; features unchanged (weather-at-target excluded from Y perturbation by design: it is an assumed-known future covariate)

short.context_assertions: make_contexts asserts every context timestamp < origin; cleaning re-run per origin
